All six matrices preserved by rejection ef6faef6 now pass exact entity/cluster metadata comparison. The original actor/usecase/component and database/queue/node/rectangle source-ownership failures are repaired.

Java CommandPackageWithUSymbol requires a terminal opening brace, while CommandCreateElementFull2 creates unbraced symbols as leaves. Rust's new terminal-brace split reproduces that boundary across all three overloaded keywords in six fresh passing matrices.

Java CommandCreateElementFull2 obtains a quark from the syntax code/alias and only calls reallyCreateLeaf when it does not exist. EntityImageDescription emits that quark's qualified name and the entity's retained creation LineLocation.

Rust ClassParser::try_entity_decl updates kind and display label for an existing relationship-created entity but does not update explicit_alias. qualify_entity consequently substitutes the display label for the stable alias code. The review3_reordered_links_before_aliases counterexample fails qualified identity while source-line ownership correctly remains at first creation.

Rust detect_uml_subtype only promotes allowmixing to CLASS when an independent class score is already nonzero. A valid Java allowmixing source containing only actor/usecase/component/queue leaves is therefore dispatched to DESCRIPTION in Rust, where the directive is partially parsed as entities all and wmixing.
The two failures are independent of shape and layout. Every Java SVG is valid XML, carries no PlantUML error marker, and reports a CLASS diagram for the heldout sources.
All sixteen fresh review3 files are byte-unique in the repository corpus. No Cargo, rustc, rustfmt, production edit, push, PR, or delivery action was performed.
